policy: Observations state what is visibly/documentarily present. No dimensions are inferred from uncalibrated images. Attribution of damage causes requires separate evidence.

observations.observation: Close view documents surviving casing blocks and exposed core/backing context.
observations.guard: Uploader comments about earthquake distortion are not adopted as causal evidence.

observations.observation: Photograph documents a red-granite casing block associated with the Khafre pyramid.
observations.guard: Material identification follows file/source description; object-scale dimensions are not inferred.

observations.observation: Interior photograph documents a passage junction/branch and visible masonry/rock surfaces.
observations.guard: No absolute section dimensions without a calibrated scale/control.

observations.observation: Photograph documents the burial chamber interior with the sarcophagus visible in context.
observations.guard: Perspective geometry requires camera calibration/control before measurement.

observations.observation: Photograph documents the Belzoni inscription; the Commons description transcribes “Scoperta da S. Belzoni. 2. Mar. 1818.”
observations.guard: Graffiti text is historical-documentary context, not ancient construction evidence.

observations.observation: Photograph documents the granite sarcophagus/coffer in the burial chamber.
observations.guard: Do not infer dimensions from the image without scale/camera solution.

observations.observation: High-resolution modern interior photograph provides a 2022 visual state and camera metadata.
observations.guard: EXIF camera metadata is useful but insufficient by itself for metric registration.

observations.observation: High-resolution 2006 interior photograph with camera/lens metadata adds an independent modern visual state.
Public-domain 1821 Belzoni/Aglio section preserves an early documented interpretation of the internal layout.
observations.guard: Historical illustration is not treated as a modern precision survey.

observations.observation: Photograph documents the causeway with the pyramid behind and later surface features along the route.
observations.guard: Causeway is not yet represented as a dedicated semantic geometry part in GIZA.

observations.observation: Geotagged exterior view supplies a 2002 camera-context record suitable for future registration sanity checks.
observations.guard: Consumer geotag is not accepted as precision survey control.

observations.observation: High-resolution interior view documents cuboid/megalithic masonry context in the Valley Temple.
observations.guard: Valley Temple is complex-context evidence and is not silently bound to pyramid-interior geometry.

observations.observation: The 2016 open-access study reports photographic documentation during 2009–2012 and in-situ verification of major fractures/cracks in 2012.
observations.guard: Crack/fracture locations are condition evidence; causal mechanisms and stability require independent structural analysis.
